detailed_description:
The target video is in a live-action, cinematic style, vertical 9:16, set in the warm golden morning bedroom <Subject 3>, with the side window casting warm high-saturation golden sunlight across the bed.
[Shot 1] A single continuous shot filmed as a doorway push-in (machine push-in) that starts at the bedroom door and moves in toward the bed, framing a medium shot of the bed and <Subject 1>'s upper body. From 0.00 to 00:02.500, <Subject 1> (S1), the East Asian Chinese man about 28 with an oval face, soft side-parted short black hair and a deep navy crew-neck short-sleeve tee with matching navy home pants, strides quickly to the bedside, grabs the corner of the quilt, and in one motion flings it fully open so the smooth bedding flips up and tosses aside; the quilt goes from flat and neat to thrown off. He calls out crisply, <d>[Chinese] 起床啦——</d>. From 00:02.500 to 00:05.000, the push-in settles and focus shifts to <Subject 2> (S2), the East Asian Chinese woman about 26 with messy tousled bed hair in a loose sleep dress, now revealed on the bed; startled by the light and the yanked quilt she rolls over, curls into a tight ball, then lifts one arm to block the light and turns her face away, going from lying flat to a curled light-shielding pose, mumbling groggily, <d>[Chinese] 唔……不要——</d>. From 00:05.000 to 00:06.000, an anchor tail holds on <Subject 2> keeping her arm raised to shield her eyes with a faint residual squirm before the clip ends.

overall_soundscape:
A warm quiet morning room tone with the sharp flap and rustle of the flung quilt and the shift of bedding as she curls.
